item.text: `EntityUtils.ts` has no existing cleanup function, and its current unit test file is the closest relevant suite. I’m adding a generic in-place traversal that handles nested objects and arrays, removes only matching string keys, and safely stops on cyclic references.

The function now deletes each matching field while traversing other values in place; a `WeakSet` prevents recursion loops and leaves untouched entities structurally identical. I’m running the repository’s app tests and TypeScript check now.
